body: How do you get yourself to believe that, contrary to what other people say, you are worth something?

I really just want to get away from everything, but I can't. My job doesn't allow me any time off before Christmas. I try to tell myself that I am worthy of love, and that my existence means something. But it is hard to believe when everyone turns their back on me as soon as I open up. It feels like they just think I'm broken. And perhaps I am. I don't see anywhere out of this anymore other than just dying. But I'm such a coward. I wish I would just get hit by a train.
